# dashboard/data

Small aggregated CSVs for the Power BI dashboard, built from the cleaned pipeline output:

```bash
python -m src.clean                    # full pipeline, writes these CSVs at the end
python -m src.clean --dashboard-only   # rebuild only these CSVs from data/processed/*.parquet
```

**Status:** generated by `python -m src.clean` from the DfT release downloaded on 2026-10-02
(see `data/raw/DOWNLOAD_LOG.json` locally). Every file is under 5 MB; the largest is
`fatal_collision_points.csv` at 1,825,491 bytes. Checks run on `yearly_totals.csv`:
fatal collisions and people killed match RAS0101 in every year from 2005 to 2019 (for example,
2014: 1,658 fatal collisions, 1,775 people killed), and collisions − (fatal + serious + slight) = 0
in every year.

## Files

| File | Grain | Key columns | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `monthly_collisions_by_severity.csv` | month | `month` (first day of month) | collisions, fatal / serious / slight collisions, KSI, adjusted serious and adjusted KSI collisions |
| `yearly_totals.csv` | year | `year`, `year_start` | collision counts by severity, plus casualty counts: casualties, killed, serious, slight, adjusted serious / slight, KSI casualties |
| `by_speed_limit.csv` | year × speed limit | `year`, `year_start`, `category` | same collision measures as the monthly file |
| `by_light_conditions.csv` | year × light condition | `year`, `year_start`, `category` | " |
| `by_road_type.csv` | year × road type | `year`, `year_start`, `category` | " |
| `by_region.csv` | year × region | `year`, `year_start`, `category` | region is mapped from police force (approximate) |
| `fatal_collision_points.csv` | one fatal collision | `collision_index`, `date`, `latitude`, `longitude` | only rows with valid coordinates (`coord_valid`) |

A missing category is written as `Missing` so it stays visible in totals. "Adjusted" columns
are sums of DfT's per-record probabilities, so they are not whole numbers.

### More exports

Generated by code, never edited by hand:

```bash
python -m src.dashboard_exports        # ksi_share_yearly, ksi_rate_by_factor, forecast_vs_actual,
                                       # data_trust, anomalous_days
# notebook 04 (last section) writes model_gains.csv
# notebook 08 (last section) writes hex_hotspots.csv and top_links_risk.csv
```

`src/dashboard_exports.py` takes the notebook numbers it needs from small files in
`reports/results/`, written by notebooks 00, 03 and 07. If a file is missing, it stops and names the notebook to run.

| File | Grain | Built by | Source of the numbers |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ksi_share_yearly.csv` | year | `src/dashboard_exports.py` | yearly pipeline aggregates |
| `ksi_rate_by_factor.csv` | factor × level, 2015-2019 | `src/dashboard_exports.py` | cleaned collisions |
| `hex_hotspots.csv` | H3 resolution-7 hexagon | notebook 08 | notebook 05 Gi\* flags (recomputed), notebook 08 rates |
| `forecast_vs_actual.csv` | month, 2017-2019 | `src/dashboard_exports.py` | SARIMA refitted with notebook 03's order (`reports/results/sarima_order.json`); test MAE checked against `reports/results/forecast_test_mae.csv` |
| `model_gains.csv` | decile of predicted risk | notebook 04 | LightGBM test predictions 2017-2019 |
| `data_trust.csv` | year | `src/dashboard_exports.py` | Kaggle rows from notebook 00 (`reports/results/kaggle_rows_by_year.csv`); pipeline; RAS0101 |
| `anomalous_days.csv` | day (top 10) | `src/dashboard_exports.py` | notebook 07 (`reports/results/anomalous_days_top10.csv`), KSI counts from the pipeline (checked against 07) |
| `top_links_risk.csv` | road link (top 50) | notebook 08 | AADF traffic counts and matched collisions |

## Data dictionary

**Shared collision measures** (`monthly_collisions_by_severity`, `yearly_totals`, `by_*`):
`collisions`, `fatal_collisions`, `serious_collisions`, `slight_collisions`, `ksi_collisions`
(fatal + serious) are counts of collisions by their most severe casualty;
`serious_collisions_adjusted` and `ksi_collisions_adjusted` are sums of DfT's severity
adjustment probabilities (comparable across the 2016+ reporting change). `year` is the
calendar year, `year_start` its 1 January (for the Date relationship), `category` the level of
the breakdown (`Missing` when not recorded).

**`yearly_totals.csv`** adds casualty counts: `casualties`, `killed`, `serious_casualties`,
`slight_casualties`, `serious_casualties_adjusted`, `slight_casualties_adjusted`,
`ksi_casualties`, `ksi_casualties_adjusted`.

**`fatal_collision_points.csv`**: `collision_index` (DfT identifier), `date`, `year`,
`latitude`, `longitude` (WGS84), `region` (from police force, approximate), `speed_limit` (mph).

**`ksi_share_yearly.csv`**
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 2005-2019 |
| `ksi_share_reported` | KSI collisions / all collisions, as recorded by the police |
| `ksi_share_adjusted` | adjusted KSI collisions / all collisions (DfT severity adjustment) |

**`ksi_rate_by_factor.csv`** (collisions 2015-2019)
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `factor` | `speed limit (mph)`, `urban or rural`, `light conditions` |
| `level` | category of the factor; `Missing` when not recorded |
| `collisions`, `ksi` | collisions and KSI collisions at that level |
| `ksi_share` | `ksi / collisions` |
| `wilson_low`, `wilson_high` | Wilson 95% interval for `ksi_share` |

**`hex_hotspots.csv`** (collisions 2015-2019)
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `h3_cell` | H3 resolution-7 cell id (average area 5.16 km², notebook 05) |
| `lat`, `lon` | hexagon centre (WGS84) |
| `collisions`, `ksi` | all collisions and KSI collisions in the hexagon (all roads) |
| `ksi_share` | `ksi / collisions` (blank if no collisions) |
| `count_hot` | Gi\* hotspot on KSI counts (notebook 05: k = 6, 999 permutations, BH FDR 0.05) |
| `share_hot` | Gi\* hotspot on KSI share; blank for hexagons with fewer than 30 collisions (not tested) |
| `rate_hot` | Gi\* hotspot on the EB KSI rate per vehicle-km (notebook 08); blank where not analysed (no major-road count point, or under 20 million vehicle-km) |
| `eb_ksi_rate_per_100m_vkm` | empirical Bayes KSI collisions per 100 million vehicle-km on major roads (notebook 08) |
| `major_road_vehicle_km` | major-road vehicle-km 2015-2019 assigned to the hexagon (via count points) |

**`forecast_vs_actual.csv`** (test period 2017-2019)
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `month` | first day of the month |
| `actual` | reported collisions in the month |
| `sarima_forecast` | SARIMA forecast fitted on 2005-2016 (order from notebook 03) |
| `sarima_80_lower` / `_upper`, `sarima_95_lower` / `_upper` | 80% and 95% prediction intervals |
| `seasonal_naive_forecast` | same month of 2016 repeated |

**`model_gains.csv`** (LightGBM, test 2017-2019)
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `decile` | 1 = the 10% of collisions with the highest predicted KSI risk |
| `collisions`, `ksi` | collisions and KSI collisions in the decile |
| `cum_share_collisions` | share of all test collisions in deciles 1..this one |
| `cum_share_ksi` | share of all test KSI collisions in deciles 1..this one (cumulative gains) |
| `lift` | KSI share in the decile / overall test KSI share |

**`data_trust.csv`**
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | 2005-2019 |
| `kaggle_rows` | rows in the rejected Kaggle copy (from notebook 00; blank outside the file's 2005-2014 range) |
| `pipeline_rows` | collisions in this project's cleaned data |
| `ras0101_collisions` | official total, table RAS0101 |
| `kaggle_minus_ras0101`, `pipeline_minus_ras0101` | differences from the official total |

**`anomalous_days.csv`** (notebook 07, daily-profile Isolation Forest)
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `rank`, `date`, `weekday` | 1 = most anomalous day 2005-2019 |
| `collisions`, `ksi`, `ksi_share` | collisions, KSI collisions and KSI share that day |
| `count_ratio` | collisions / that year's average day |
| `ice_snow_share`, `snow_share`, `fog_share`, `dark_share` | share of the day's collisions on icy or snowy roads, in snow, in fog, in darkness |
| `weekend` | 1 if Saturday or Sunday |
| `most_unusual_feature` | the feature furthest from normal (z-score under the training scaler) |

**`top_links_risk.csv`** (major roads 2015-2019; links with at least 20 million vehicle-km)
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `rank` | 1 = highest EB KSI rate |
| `road_name`, `road_group`, `local_authority`, `link_start`, `link_end` | the link (DfT traffic count point) and where it runs |
| `lat`, `lon` | count point location |
| `vehicle_km` | AADF x link length x 365, summed over the years with a count |
| `collisions`, `ksi` | collisions and KSI collisions matched to the link (same road, within 2 km) |
| `raw_ksi_rate_per_100m_vkm`, `ci_low`, `ci_high` | raw rate with exact Poisson 95% interval |
| `eb_ksi_rate_per_100m_vkm` | empirical Bayes rate (shrunk towards the road group's mean) |

## Date table spec

Created in Power BI with DAX (full code in `../measures.md`), not loaded from a file:

| Column | Type | Example | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Date` | date | 2016-03-01 | key; one row per day, 2005-01-01 to 2019-12-31, no gaps |
| `Year` | whole number | 2016 | slicers, axis |
| `Month Number` | whole number | 3 | sort key for `Month` |
| `Month` | text | Mar | axis label (sort by `Month Number`) |
| `Year Month` | text | 2016-03 | monthly axis label |
| `Quarter` | text | Q1 | optional grouping |

Relationships (single direction, many-to-one, Date table on the "one" side):
- `monthly_collisions_by_severity[month]` → `Date[Date]`
- `yearly_totals[year_start]` → `Date[Date]`
- each `by_*[year_start]` → `Date[Date]`
- `fatal_collision_points[date]` → `Date[Date]`

Mark `Date` as the date table (Table tools → Mark as date table → `Date[Date]`) so
`SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR` works.
